page.overview:
What is Akota?

Akota was a mysterious country somewhere beyond the western shores of Zakhara.

Akota exported gold, slaves, wood, and exotic goods to the Land of Fate through the city of Akota to the city of Tajar.

It had its own language called Akotan, which was also spoken in Zakhara's western settlements that were conducting trade with exotic Akota.

The Scholar's View of Toril map from the Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition and the Forgotten Realms Interactive Atlas show a number of islands of greatly varying size to the west of Zakhara. Some or all of them may represent the country of Akota. Otherwise, Akota may lie on the continents of Katashaka or Arandron.
